units.source_text: [\[27\]](#part1333.html#w27) 当时认为，接触过死人的人，身上不洁，不可请来客坐，只可与他隔帘立谈。

en.t: [27] At the time, it was believed that anyone who had touched a dead person was ritually impure, so guests could not be invited in and seated with them; one could only stand and speak with them from behind a curtain.
